svg.title: When honest originals bust out, by reopen strategy and tourist share
svg.desc: Nine histograms of bust-out day over all genuine stalls and 30 seeds; the last bar is stalls that never bust out; the vertical line is the median. The summary gives every value.
svg.text: When honest originals bust out, by reopen strategy and tourist share
Mean bust-out day, look-alike − fresh (tourists 40%): −1.47 days [−1.96, −0.98]
Bazaar engine 0.8.0; rule_genuine_rational (benchmark): bust out when one day's harvest exceeds days left × yesterday's units × today's premium.
Bars share one count scale (max 188 stalls). All genuine stalls in 30 seeds per panel; 2 patrolling inspectors, naive deceptive sellers,
